name: zalo-apple-glass-ui
description: Desktop client for personal Zalo accounts, built with Electron and zca-js.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run check && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --x64 && node tools/hash-release.cjs && node tools/mark-delivery.cjs && node tools/verify-asar.cjs
